questions.explanation: Hispanohablante literally means 'Spanish-speaking' and doesn't change for gender.

questions.q: How many sovereign countries have Spanish as their official idioma?
questions.explanation: Spanish is official in 20 sovereign countries, across Europe, Africa, North America, and South America.

questions.q: Which of these is a U.S. territory (not a sovereign country) where Spanish is also co-official, often called the unofficial '21st' member of the Spanish-speaking world?
questions.explanation: Puerto Rico speaks Spanish and is often included on maps of the Spanish-speaking world, but it's a U.S. territory, not its own country.

questions.q: Which Spanish-speaking country has the largest población?
questions.explanation: México's población (about 130 million) is far larger than any other Spanish-speaking country's.

questions.q: About what fraction of Washington state's population identifies as Hispanic or Latino?
questions.explanation: U.S. Census Bureau estimates put it at roughly one in eight Washington residents.
